summary.text: Valorie Taylor is a Republican member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Rutland-11 District, appointed to the seat in January 2026, and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Valorie Taylor was born in Rutland, Vermont, earned a high school diploma from Mill River Union High School in 1995, and studied at the University of Vermont until 1997.
Her career experience includes assisting with her family business, Taylor Tree and Land Management, and working as a residential painter, optician and assistant manager.
Taylor has served on the selectboard in Mendon, Vermont.
Taylor was appointed to the Rutland-11 District seat on January 2, 2026, succeeding Jim Harrison (R), and assumed office on January 6, 2026.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026, and her current term ends on January 6, 2027.
